customManagers.description: action.yml `*_VERSION=` pins inside run: scripts, annotated with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` line directly above (yamllint, pinned so every runner gives the same verdict: dvystrcil/prometheus#66). No built-in manager reads a shell variable, so without this the pin is never bumped. If this regex stops matching, Renovate goes silent rather than erroring; tests/test_renovate_tracking.py runs this regex against action.yml and fails if any pin is uncaptured.

packageRules.description: A yamllint bump can add or tighten rules and turn consumer repos red once v1 moves. Never automerge; the PR's self-test runs the new version against the #66 fixture, and consumers should be checked before moving v1.
